verdict.rationale: Morph documents that it serves open-weight chat models, such as Kimi K3, and publishes a machine-readable model feed. Nothing in the evidence describes how quickly newly released open-weight models are added after their public release: no release-cadence commitment, launch-day availability claim, or changelog of model additions. Having a model catalog is a different capability from fast onboarding of new releases, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
